Let the ponytail sweep behind one shoulder, with fine gold-lit strands. The supporting railing stays beneath the waist and does not obscure hands. Luminous turquoise sky, bright yellow climbing flowers, cobalt and emerald leaves, distant peach garden wall and warm sun flecks. The same fine colored linework, glowing skin, detailed eyes and lively natural scenery as the reference. Strong lake-blue versus warm gold relationship, inviting confident expression, accurate natural fingers and opaque secure summer fashion.
